what_this_is: For every governed numeric column, what states the resolution of the method that produced it -- or, honestly, that nothing does.
does_not_mean: that a column with a CARRIER is measured, or that one with NO_FLOOR_DEFINED is wrong. MODEL-ONLY / FORECAST-ONLY; PASS remains 0.

vocabulary.CARRIER: another column in the same artefact publishes this one's resolution class; resolution_from names it
vocabulary.FLOOR: this column is the declared resolution floor itself
vocabulary.COORDINATE: an independent variable set by the mesh or the output schedule, not produced by the solve
vocabulary.EXACT_BY_CONSTRUCTION: a count or an ordinal; no floating-point method, so no resolution to state
vocabulary.NO_FLOOR_DEFINED: the gap. The method that produces this column has no declared floor, so the number is published without saying what could be resolved
vocabulary.INPUT_CONSTANT: a declared parameter copied into the output rather than produced by a method; its value is exactly what the configuration says
